objective: Independently verify the implemented verifier's mutation behavior, read-only guarantee, legacy-package compatibility, and supported-runtime evidence without editing repository files.
deliverable: A read-only verification receipt containing exact commands, mutation findings, runtime facts available locally, compatibility counts, and residual uncertainty.
write_scope: Automatically cleaned unittest TemporaryDirectory paths outside the repository

authoritative_facts: This task must not edit repository files.
Local Windows execution can verify only installed Python runtimes; GitHub Actions is the final Linux/Windows four-cell oracle after an authorized branch push.
Integrity is relative to a trusted manifest and does not establish authenticity.
v0.2 and v0.3 packages are immutable positive integration fixtures.
user_constraints: No repository writes, historical mutation, dependencies, network, public push, tag, or release.
permissions: Run read-only repository commands and tests that write only to automatically cleaned temporary directories.
non_goals: Do not repair findings, edit CI or docs, claim unexecuted Linux evidence, or assess signatures/authenticity.

acceptance_checks: Run the targeted and full test commands once on each locally available supported Python runtime and report exact counts and exit statuses.
Run the new verifier separately against unchanged v0.2 and v0.3 and report zero findings plus exact entry counts.
Run the existing structural validator separately against v0.2 and v0.3.
Inspect the complete mutation corpus for exact expected/actual finding-set assertions, repeatability, and before/after package identities.
Report the supported-matrix cells not locally executed as pending CI rather than passing.
evidence_required: before/after repository status and package identities
pending CI cells and residual caveats
